shortcuts.action: Send review: opens the Send sheet for the review in Neovim's current tab, and in the sheet sends its open comments
shortcuts.when: a review tab with open comments is current in Neovim

commands.title: Open file
commands.description: Open a file in the workspace's Neovim, starting it if needed, optionally at a line and column. An absolute path inside another git worktree of a workspace folder switches that folder to the worktree first and opens the file there.

path.description: File to open; absolute, or relative to Neovim's working directory (the selected worktree of the first workspace folder that exists, else home).

line.description: 1-based line to put the cursor on; 0 or absent keeps the default position.

col.description: 1-based byte column on that line, clamped to the line length; 0 or absent puts the cursor at the line start. Ignored without line.

focus.description: Also show the Neovim section and focus Neovim.

commands.title: Show in quickfix
commands.description: Replace the workspace Neovim's quickfix list with the given locations, open the quickfix window and show the Neovim section. Returns once validated; nvim fills the list asynchronously in small batches. Takes 1 to 10000 items; only items in the first 1000 distinct files are kept, and the title then gets " (first 1000 files)". Unknown fields are rejected.

title.description: Quickfix list title, at most 512 chars without line breaks or NUL.

path.description: Absolute file path, at most 4096 bytes, without line breaks or NUL.

col.description: 1-based byte column up to 2147483647; 0 or absent for none.

text.description: Entry text, at most 512 chars, without NUL.

commands.title: Open review
commands.description: Open a review of head against base for the user in its worktree's Neovim (Diffview with its review file panel) and show it at once in the Code section. base defaults to main; a branch base is compared from its merge-base with head. head defaults to your worktree's working tree; a branch checked out in a worktree of the repo means that worktree's working tree (editable, its nrev comments and marks); a branch or commit checked out nowhere is its tip, read-only, opened in your worktree. You become the review's opener: the user's Send hands the review comments back to you as one message. Asking again for the same worktree, base and head reuses the open review and makes you the opener. Returns {id, worktree, base, head}.

base.description: Left side: a branch (compared from its merge-base with head) or a commit; default main.

head.description: Right side: a branch or commit; absent for the working tree of your worktree (or of cwd).

cwd.description: Absolute path inside the worktree the review is for, instead of your own worktree.

commands.title: Show review
commands.description: Make the open review with this id the selected one, switch its folder's worktree when it lives in another Neovim, make its tab current and show the Code section with Neovim focused. Fails for an id that is not open in the workspace.

id.description: Review id (rv_ and 8 hex digits) from the editor-nvim.review bus topic.

commands.title: Open Diffview
commands.description: Open a review of the working tree of the git worktree containing cwd (uncommitted and untracked files included) against rev in that worktree's Neovim, switching the workspace folder to it when it is not the selected one, and show it in the Code section. With turn the left side reads Before turn <turn>; session becomes the review's opener. Reuses an open review of the same worktree and rev. When the diffview host API is missing, Neovim's error shows as the open failed badge and the command fails.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the worktree root.

rev.description: Commit sha, 7 to 40 lowercase hex digits.

session.description: Agent session whose turn is reviewed; it becomes the review's opener.

turn.description: Turn number of that session; the left side is labelled Before turn <turn>.

commands.title: Current selection
commands.description: The current or last visual selection of the current root's Neovim: {path, startLine, endLine, text}. Fails with no selection when there is none or Neovim is not running.

commands.title: Reload changed files
commands.description: Run :checktime in every running Neovim of the workspace so buffers changed on disk under the given root reload; a no-op when none runs.

root.description: Absolute path whose files changed on disk.

commands.title: Stop worktree Neovim
commands.description: Stop the workspace's Neovim whose root is the given path and keep it from starting there again until editor-nvim.release-root. Fails like restart while it has unsaved buffers, unless force is true. Only marks the root when no such Neovim exists.

root.description: Absolute root path of the Neovim, as listed in the workspace roots.

force.description: Stop even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.

commands.title: Unsaved buffers
commands.description: List the modified buffers of every running Neovim of the workspace whose files are inside the given root, except files another Neovim holds inside its own root, as workspace-relative names; [] when there are none. Never stops or starts Neovim; fails with unsaved buffers: unknown when it does not respond.

root.description: Absolute root path of the Neovim, as listed in the workspace roots.

commands.title: Guard branch switch
commands.description: Refuse a branch switch of the given root with Save or discard unsaved changes first: <names> while a running Neovim of the workspace has modified buffers inside it, as editor-nvim.unsaved lists them.

root.description: Absolute root path of the folder being switched.

commands.title: Release worktree Neovim
commands.description: End a stop-root: Neovim may start in the given root again, and starts now when it is still the workspace's current root.

root.description: Absolute root path passed to stop-root.

commands.title: Reveal file in Finder
commands.description: Reveal the file currently open in Neovim in Finder.

commands.title: Open terminal here
commands.description: Open a new terminal in the directory of the file open in Neovim, or in the current root.

commands.title: Import my nvim config
commands.description: Start an agent session in the Agents section that reads ~/.config/nvim and moves the user's own keymaps, options, autocmds and plugins into Clubmate's Neovim user layer, following the bundled nvim guide. Fails with open a folder workspace first in the home workspace and with no ~/.config/nvim to import when that directory is missing.

commands.title: Restart Neovim
commands.description: Restart every running Neovim of the workspace (one per worktree). Fails while file buffers in any of them have unsaved changes, or while a running Neovim does not answer (unsaved buffers: unknown), unless force is true.

force.description: Restart even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.
